name: mysterium
description: Docker-first MCP server for authenticated D&D Beyond content

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:offline && npm run test:browser:only
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/character-pdf.test.mjs test/ci-isolation.test.mjs test/docker-session-safeguards.test.mjs test/library.test.mjs test/navigate.test.mjs test/search.test.mjs test/session-path.test.mjs test/session-state.test.mjs test/stat-block.test.mjs test/tool-behavior.test.mjs test/tool-contracts.test.mjs test/version.test.mjs
scripts.test:offline: npm run test:unit && npm run test:mcp
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:only
scripts.test:docker: docker build --tag mysterium:test . && MYSTERIUM_TEST_IMAGE=mysterium:test npm run test:docker:run
